basic_details.job_title: HBCH & RC Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Senior Resident, One Year Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview of Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre (HBCH & RC), Punjab, a unit of Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, is on 25 November 2026, with reporting between 9.00 AM and 11.00 AM. The venue is Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Plot No. 1, Medicity, New Chandigarh, SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab-140901. Indian Nationals can attend for one Senior Resident (Gastroenterology and HPB Oncology) post for six months and one One Year Fellow (Gynecology Oncology) post for one year, with pay of Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/- per month.

age_limit.details: The age limit for both posts is maximum up to 40 Yrs. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview. Experience is reckoned after the required qualifications. The notice does not print a minimum age.

content_sections.heading: About HBCH & RC
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Punjab, is described on its letterhead as a unit of Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, and a grant-in-aid institution of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The notice is issued by its Academics Department under Reference No. TMC/HBCHRC/M/ACA/RECT/22/26, dated 29.10.2026, and is signed by the Director, HBCH & RC, Punjab.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Duration: six months. Location: HBCH & RC, New Chandigarh. Duration: one year from the date of joining. Location: HBCH, Sangrur. The age limit for both posts is maximum up to 40 Yrs. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview. Experience is reckoned after the required qualifications. The notice does not print a minimum age. If a post is only for the unreserved category, age relaxation is not applicable to reserved candidates. Reservation of posts under various categories applies as per Govt. Rules. Salary is determined on the relevant work experience acquired after completion of the essential qualification. Tata Memorial Centre may also exercise the option to offer appointments for a fixed term, initially for one year, on a consolidated remuneration. Senior Residents may be provided sharing accommodation subject to availability, on a chargeable basis. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Photocopies of the following documents are to be submitted at the time of the interview: Resume and 2 recent passport size photographs (mandatory). Date of birth proof: Birth Certificate, School leaving Certificate or SSC passing certificate. Educational qualification: mark sheet and passing certificate for all examinations. Past employment: experience certificate showing the date of joining and relieving. Current employment: appointment letter and last pay slip. Copy of PAN Card and Aadhaar Card. Caste certificate in the Government of India format; Caste Validity Certificate in case of ST; Non-Creamy Layer Certificate in case of OBC (mandatory). Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate in valid format. Persons with Disability: Physical Disability Certificate. Candidates should also carry the original documents for verification. Persons working under Central / State Government, an autonomous body, a semi-government organization or a Public Sector Undertaking must obtain permission from their Head of the Organization and produce it at the interview. Without it they will not be allowed to appear.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates attend the interview at the Academics Department, 4th Floor, Wing-C, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Punjab-140901. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to fix a minimum eligibility standard or benchmark and to restrict the number of candidates called for interview, taking into account factors such as the number of vacancies and the percentage of marks in Graduate / Post Graduate degrees. It also reserves the right to fix a minimum eligibility standard when finalizing the candidates for selection after the interview. The decision of the Director, HBCH & RC, Punjab is final and binding, and no correspondence in this regard is entertained.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidature is cancelled if a candidate is found at any stage not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have furnished incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact. Services may be terminated forthwith if a shortcoming is detected even after appointment. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidature. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute is at SAS Nagar.

faq.question: Q1. When is the HBCH & RC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026 (25.11.2026) for both the Senior Resident and the One Year Fellow posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the HBCH & RC walk-in?
faq.answer: Reporting is between 09.00 AM and 11.00 AM at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Plot No. 1, Medicity, New Chandigarh, SAS Nagar (Mohali), Punjab-140901. Candidates attend at the Academics Department, 4th Floor, Wing-C.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in HBCH & RC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Senior Resident (Gastroenterology and HPB Oncology) for six months and 1 One Year Fellow (Gynecology Oncology) for one year.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The notice requires M.Ch/DNB (Surgical Gastroenterology) OR M.Ch/DNB (Surgical Oncology) OR MS (General Surgery).

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the One Year Fellow post?
faq.answer: The notice requires M.S./MD (Obstetrics & Gynecology) OR equivalent PG Degree recognized by MCI/NMC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is maximum up to 40 Yrs, reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PWD, with further additions as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: Pay for both posts is Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/- per month. It is determined on the relevant work experience acquired after completion of the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should candidates carry?
faq.answer: Candidates carry photocopies of the resume, 2 passport size photographs, date of birth proof, mark sheets and certificates, experience documents, PAN and Aadhaar, and caste, EWS or disability certificates where applicable. Original documents are also needed for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Do government employees need permission to attend?
faq.answer: Yes. Persons working under Central or State Government, autonomous bodies, semi-government organizations or PSUs must produce permission from their Head of the Organization at the interview, or they will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q10. Will accommodation be provided to Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Senior Residents may be provided sharing accommodation, subject to availability and on a chargeable basis.
